description: fetch the pull-mode envelope for the next unexecuted step of a Work Breakdown Structure: resolved arguments, support articles, the expected result contract, completion criteria, and the auto-safe flag.
embedding_description: Fetch the next executable step of a work breakdown structure with everything needed to run it: sub-steps with bound and Composed-resolved arguments, support article filenames, the expected result contract, completion criteria, and whether the step is marked auto-safe. Read-only; repeatable; the envelope also signals await-user control steps and overall completion.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Step envelope with keys: kind, wbs_id, step_number, title, process_keys, sub_steps, support_articles, result_processor_kind, auto_safe, expected_result_contract, completion_criteria, remaining_step_numbers
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with kind and step_number/title, then the sub-steps with their resolved arguments and any unresolved Composed targets the driver must supply.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Execute the sub-steps with your own tools, then submit the outcome via record_wbs_step_observation. Read the listed support_articles first when present. Stop for the operator on kind='await_user'.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetching the next unexecuted step of a Work Breakdown Structure in pull mode. get_next_wbs_step accepts {wbs_id}; it reads durable state and changes nothing.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFound: no WBS tracking row or document exists for this wbs_id. ValidationError: the arguments do not conform to the schema, or the stored WBS document fails to parse.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: NotFound: verify the wbs_id. Parse failures: the stored document is malformed — repair it via patch_work_breakdown_structure before pulling steps.
